title: Graceful state DR drill for latency-sensitive KV sync and load-shedding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Validate an active-passive failover path for a latency-sensitive KV-backed feature (prefix KV for prompt caching) with graceful circuit-breaker engagement and automated load-shedding, ensuring SLOs degrade predictably and backups/restore prove integrity. Deliverables: (1) an executable DR drill playbook that can be run with oncall and SRE in 45–60 minutes, (2) a validated backup and restore checklist for prefix KV and snapshot reconciliation, (3) metrics and a test harness that proves service-level behaviour (error-rate, p50/p95 latency, token throughput) during progressive capacity loss and controlled failover, (4) automated post-dr verification checks and an incident postmortem template for drill learnings.
steps: Pre-drill: update runbook in Confluence (link below) and ensure playbook owner and oncall are notified
Snapshot: take consistent KV snapshot via internal snapshot service; record snapshot hash and s3 path
Baseline: capture 30m pre-dr telemetry - latency (p50/p95), error rate, queue depth, average KV hit ratio
Simulate: inject regional capacity loss by taking active region routing weight to 20% then 0% (traffic siphon), observe circuit-breaker thresholds and auto-fallback
Failover: promote passive region via automated promote script with staged load (30% -> 60% -> 100%), monitoring per-route SLO alarms
Load-shedding: validate tiered shedding policy for non-critical routes and confirm graceful degradation for high-priority routes
KV resync: run incremental KV reconciliation (snapshot-apply -> tombstone pass -> consistency check) and confirm KV hash matches primary
Restore validation: run synthetic prompt workloads against restored state to verify correctness and no token-level regressions
Rollback: ensure circuit-breaker unwrap and rollback path is tested by rebalancing traffic back to primary region and confirming state convergence
Post-dr: generate automated verification report and schedule a 1-hour postmortem within 48 hours
acceptance_criteria: Automated runbook completes end-to-end under test plan and finishes within 60 minutes with >90% checklist completion
Post-restore KV hash matches pre-failover snapshot hash
Critical route SLOs: p95 latency increase <= 2x baseline and error rate increase <= 1% absolute during failover
Circuit-breaker engages at configured thresholds and fallback model variant served with validated format compatibility
All changes merged to infra repo and runbook updated with exact commands used

Operational coordination risk: need clear communication templates for oncall handoff between regions
